certificate_algorithm: Reject unknown/missing fields relative to the frozen V2 family and source-snapshot schemas.
Reject any forbidden input field anywhere in the family descriptor or static replayability witness, including local_source_competence_preoutcome and per-family model/behavioral evaluability fields.
Verify source_snapshot_sha256 from canonical externally sealed snapshot bytes before using any witness.

Require exactly one static_graph_replayability_witness for family.source_graph_id and mechanically verify deterministic pre-reset state-chain reachability, reset-state identity, immediate-command legality, common-prefix legality/order, branch classes, and divergence depth.
Canonicalize branch equivalence classes as sorted unique strings and require A and B nonempty/disjoint.
Require divergence_depth_after_immediate >= 1 and at least two distinct common-prefix transition keys so a nonidentity temporal control is constructible.

No per-family behavioral/model competence predicate participates in source admission. Any later model evaluability requirement is a separately frozen whole-split pre-outcome guard that can only accept or invalidate the entire frozen split; it may not drop, replace, reorder, resample, or tune individual families.

Compute structural_family_key_sha256 = SHA256(canonical V2 family descriptor). This is byte-equivalent to the V1 recipe applied to the same structural family after removing local_source_competence_preoutcome.
Compute family_id = SHA256(canonical {generator_identity_sha256, cohort_namespace, source_snapshot_sha256, structural_family_key_sha256}).
Sort admitted certificates by structural_family_key_sha256 and forbid duplicate structural keys.

development_authority.selection: all statically replayable generator-admitted families in structural-key order; no per-family model/behavioral competence filter; any later whole-split model evaluability guard is non-filtering and separately frozen before outcomes

proof_obligations: pre_reset_steps commands exactly equal allowed_pre_reset_history_canonical in order
state chain starts at initial_state_id and ends at reset_state_id
immediate_step starts at reset_state_id and command exactly equals immediate_next_command_canonical
common_prefix_steps form a contiguous state chain after immediate_step and transition keys exactly equal common_prefix_transition_keys in order
branch equivalence classes and divergence depth exactly match family descriptor
witness is part of the externally sealed source snapshot and contains no forbidden/future/oracle/outcome fields
